subject: Acceptance velocity: MAP + security gates (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — proposed timeline
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@riverbank.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Acceptance velocity: MAP + security gates (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — proposed timeline

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the call today. Per our discussion I've attached a first-pass MAP (Draft_MAP_Riverbank.xlsx) and the Redwood SOC 2 Type II statement. Read-through highlights:

- Acceptance gates: SOC 2 evidence + SIG/CAIQ summary + mutually agreed DPA redlines.
- Retention ask: 90 days hot token retention + 24 months cold logs (default) — please confirm if Riverbank requires EU residency or additional escrow.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can provide a prioritized subset for initial review (30 answers) and the full export within 10 business days.

Proposed close velocity:
1) 7 business days — SIG subset review
2) 10 business days — DPA review + redline round
3) 14 calendar days — SOC 2 evidence handoff + verification

If that timeline works we'll update the MAP milestones and owners. Can Jordan be the evidence owner for SOC 2 items and Kimberly for DPA negotiation?

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm retention window and whether Riverbank needs EU-only hosting or escrow.
- Tom (if included): any procurement constraints we should factor into the close timeline.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Head of Evals, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: Draft_MAP_Riverbank.xlsx; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Statement_2028.pdf

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@riverbank.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@riverbank.co>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acceptance velocity: MAP + security gates (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — proposed timeline

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — helpful. Quick clarifications from Riverbank:

- Retention: we need 180 days hot token retention and 36 months for audit logs. We can accept 24 months if there's a documented contract carveout; would prefer EU residency for PII processing (Riverbank has customers in the EU).
- SIG: if you can prioritize the CAIQ subset (30 q's) that will let our security team unblock a lot sooner. Full SIG export within 10 business days is fine.
- DPA: our legal team will push standard redlines. Can you confirm Redwood's stance on subprocessor disclosure timelines? We typically need a subprocessor list within 5 business days of signature.

We plan to run a 2-week POC once the SIG subset and basic DPA terms are in place — that should be enough to validate latency/observability for our flows.

Tom — looped in for procurement timing; can we aim for an initial signature by Aug 24?

Elena

Elena Morris
Security Program Manager, Riverbank Finance
elena.morris@riverbank.co

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@riverbank.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acceptance velocity: MAP + security gates (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — proposed timeline

Elena — appreciate the specifics. Quick answers:

- Retention: we can accept 180 days hot retention and 36 months audit logs as contract language. For EU residency we can route Riverbank traffic to our eu-central-1 region (Redwood Private or hosted with EU region). I'll note dependency in the MAP.
- Subprocessor disclosure: Redwood provides an up-to-date list via our compliance portal; we can share the current list with 3 business days post-signature and will notify 30 days prior to any new subprocessor going live.
- SIG subset: Jordan will own the 30-question CAIQ subset and deliver within 5 business days. Full SIG export (mechanized) committed in 10 business days.

Proposed updated timeline (MAP milestone changes):
- SIG subset: target Aug 5 (5 business days)
- DPA redline round 1: target Aug 9 (5 business days)
- SOC 2 evidence handoff: target Aug 14 (10 business days)
- 2-week POC window: Aug 15–28
- Target exec sign: Aug 24 (aligned with POC midpoint)

Kimberly will lead the DPA redline run — I've attached a DPA playbook stub and flagged key carveouts we anticipate (data residency, escrow, subprocessor notice).

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and circulate a DocuSign link for an initial MOU when we have DPA guardrails.

Regards,

Naomi
Attachments: DPA_Playbook_v1.pdf
Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=map_riverbank_v2

Forwarding a quick internal note before we reply to Riverbank on DPA details.

On Tue, Jul 30, 2028 at 10:08 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi's message...

Internal next steps / questions:
- I'll take the DPA redlines. My ask: legal needs 7 business days to produce a clean redline back to Riverbank; that aligns with Jordan's SIG timeline so combined we still hit the Aug 14 evidence handoff.
- I'll propose we include a specific EU data residency clause with an SLA for region routing and an option for on-premise/private deployment (Commercial add-on).
- For subprocessor disclosure: offer the "current list within 3 business days post-signature" and a quarterly notice cadence thereafter; legal prefers 30 days' notice for new subprocessors (ok to offer 30-day notice, not 5 days).
- Jordan: please escalate any SIG items that require subsystem-level diagrams (KV cache, prefix caching, telemetry) — Riverbank may ask for deeper evidence during POC.
